messages:
Asha (CS): Heads-up: WillowBay onboarding — customer reports morning latency spikes on invoice chat (P95 jumping during 09:30-10:15 local). Renewal ~55 days. Need low-risk ops recs.
Micah (Solutions): saw heatmap. model/region?
Asha (CS): redwood/gpt-large, hosted eu-central, FP16. typical prompts: invoice extraction + short summary (40-120 tokens). P95 from ~1.0s -> ~3.4s during bursts; tokens/cost +12%.
HealthBot: automated insight: bursts align with scheduled batch imports. Recommend KV-prefix caching + int8 pilot for short requests. Estimated cost delta ~-20%, P95 -27% on sampled traces.
Jon (SE): propose minimal-risk pilot: 1) create redwood/gpt-large:int8-canary for requests <1500 tokens; 2) 10% traffic canary; 3) if eu p99>2.5s -> fallback to us-central; 4) enable prefix caching for invoice templates; 5) run 250-sample QA.
Priya (Eng): add tags and rollback: tag traces `willowbay-canary-7952468010`; auto-rollback if extraction accuracy drops >1% or error rate +10% in 24h. Ensure streaming contract identical.
Micah (Solutions): draft to customer should include expected KPIs: cost ~-20%, P95 ~-25%, 48h QA checkpoint, and manual review of flagged outliers.
Asha (CS): please include quick how-to so their infra team can opt-out per-route if needed. I'll collect feedback and 50 random prompts after 48h.
Jon (SE): implementation snippet:
```
- model: redwood/gpt-large:int8-canary
- routing rule: if region==eu-central and p99_latency>2.5s -> route to us-central (policy: eu-fallback-us)
- traffic: 90% fp16 / 10% int8 for tokens<1500
- eval: s3://redwood-evals/willowbay-invoice-250.csv
- logging: token-diff + extraction-accuracy
```
HealthBot: pre-canary eval (200 samples) shows precision delta 0.2% (within noise), 5 edge cases flagged (date parsing). Recommend manual QA on those.
Micah (Solutions): I'll prepare pilot note + rollback SLAs by EOD. Asha, want a short kickoff call tomorrow?
Asha (CS): yes 30m with CSM + Solutions. Thanks team.
Priya (Eng): Ops will schedule auto-eval at 48h and post results here.
Asha (CS): will share customer feedback summary and samples after 48h. :white_check_mark:
